title: 第19章 韩图
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
掌门从山门外走进来的时候，青色道袍的袖口还沾着后山竹林里的露水。

    他手里握着那把通体青碧色的长剑，剑身上流转的灵光深沉内敛，每一步都踩得碎石堆上的石板微微下陷。

    钱长老和孙老跟在身后，孙老拄着竹杖，钱长老手里捏着那面测魔盘。

    阵法堂周长老走在最后，低着头，袖子里鼓鼓囊囊不知道塞了什么。

    “贺九。血煞宗外事长老，跑到我苍梧宗来抢人，还打伤我的长老。你觉得自己今天能活着走出这扇山门吗。”掌门停下脚步，长剑斜指地面。

    贺九咧嘴一笑，露出两排泛黄的牙齿。

    “掌门亲自出马，我确实打不过。不过你在来之前有没有想过一个问题——陈元去哪了。”

    掌门没有回答。

    贺九往后山方向努了努下巴，“他去了药材库，取人傀之术的最后几味药材。最多再有一炷香他就回来。等他回来的时候，你要面对的不止是我们三个血煞宗的人——还有一个被抹掉意识的混沌圣体人傀。你猜他第一个命令是什么。”

    掌门握剑的手没有丝毫变化。

    但他身侧的孙老忽然感觉到一股极其微弱的灵力波动从山门外传来——极其微弱，但异常冰冷，像是有什么东西正在从地底下往外钻。

    山门外的地面裂开了。

    一道灰白色的身影从地缝中钻出，带起一片碎石和泥土。

    那是一个人的形状——但已经不太像人了。

    灰白色的皮肤紧紧绷在骨骼上，眼眶深陷，眼珠已经变成了灰白色，嘴唇干瘪收缩露出两排完整的牙齿。

    他身上穿着一件破旧的道袍，款式是苍梧宗三十年前的旧式样，胸口绣着苍梧宗的宗门徽记——一只展翅的苍鹰。

    掌门看着那件道袍，握剑的手猛地收紧了一分。

    “韩图。”

    韩图。

    前任苍梧宗掌门，现任掌门的师兄，三十年前在闭关中“走火入魔而死”。

    宗门典籍里记载的是暴毙，尸骨无存。

    现在他站在这里——或者说，他的尸体站在这里。

    韩图的头僵硬地转动了一下，灰白色的眼珠对准掌门，嘴角咧开露出一个极其诡异的笑容。

    然后他动了——没有灵力爆发，没有剑气破空，直接朝掌门扑了过来，五指成爪朝掌门面门抓下。

    掌门一剑格挡，剑身与指甲碰撞的瞬间炸开一串火星。

    韩图的手指被剑芒震开，指尖在剑身上刮出刺耳的摩擦声——他的指甲保持着生前的韧度，没有断裂，甚至没有变形。

    “三十年前你不是走火入魔。”掌门的声音低沉到几乎听不见，“是陈元。”

    韩图没有回答。

    他已经回答不了了。

    他的眼珠里没有一丝意识残留，只有被炼成人傀后留下的空洞。

    贺九趁掌门分神对付韩图的瞬间绕到了他身后，五根暗红色的指甲朝掌门后腰抓去。

    这一爪如果抓实了，血煞爪的毒素就能直接渗进掌门的丹田。

    就在这当口，周长老从袖子里掏出了一面阵旗——暗红色的旗面上绣着密密麻麻的禁制符文，这不是苍梧宗的阵法，是血煞宗的血煞困灵阵。

    “周长老！”孙老猛地转过头，竹杖点地，“你在干什么！”

    周长老没有回答。

    他的额头在冒汗，手在发抖，但阵旗已经激活了。

    暗红色的阵纹从旗面上蔓延出来，沿着地面迅速扩展成一个巨大的圆形法阵，将掌门、韩图、贺九和两个血煞宗护法全部笼罩在内。

    “三十年前韩掌门的事……我有份。”周长老的声音抖得几乎听不清，但每个字都清清楚楚地传进了在场所有人的耳朵里，“陈元给韩图下毒的时候，是我帮他开的韩图闭关密室的禁制。我是阵法堂长老，只有我能解那扇门的禁制。后来他把韩图炼成人傀，我被他捏住了把柄——那扇密室禁制的阵图上有我的灵力印记，他把阵图保存了三十年。这些年我帮他贪了宗门不少灵石，每一笔账他都留着底。我没办法。”

    孙老拄着竹杖的手青筋暴起。

    韩图是他的师弟，三十年前暴毙，尸骨无存，他查了整整三年，什么都没查到。

    现在韩图的尸体就站在他面前，被人炼成了一具会动的傀儡。

    他的竹杖在石板上重重一顿，整个人朝周长老冲了过去，万象心经的灵力在竹杖上凝聚成一道淡白色的光刃，劈头盖脸朝周长老砸下。

    “你他妈个畜生！”孙老一杖接一杖地砸下去，每一杖都带着三十年的愤怒。

    周长老被他逼到了阵法边缘，阵旗上已经裂开了两道细纹，但他始终没有还手——他不是打不过孙老，他是知道自己没资格还手。

    掌门在困灵阵里被韩图和贺九双面夹击。

    韩图的攻击没有任何灵力波动，纯靠肉身速度和生前残留的战斗本能，但他生前的剑法造诣极高，出招角度刁钻到连掌门都不得不收剑回防。

    贺九的血煞爪专攻下盘，每次掌门抬剑格挡韩图的正面冲击，他就从侧后方抓向掌门的腿弯和腰侧。

    两个血煞宗护法在外围用血影步骚扰，不让掌门冲出阵法的缺口。

    林尘从碎石堆上冲了下来。

    他体内的灵力只剩下不到两成，碎星被陈元拿走了，匕首在对付宋芹的时候已经用钝了。

    但他看到了周长老脚下那面阵旗——困灵阵的核心在阵旗上，只要阵旗破了，困灵阵就会消散。

    他的瞬身步还剩最后一次。

    周长老一旗挡开孙老的竹杖，整个人往右横移两步避开追击，正好移到林尘身前不到三步远的地方。

    就是现在——林尘刚想发动瞬身步，一只手从身后扣住了他的肩膀。

    那只手很凉，指腹上有厚厚的老茧，指甲泛着暗紫色的光泽。

    唐玉站在他身后，另一只手里夹着一根细长的银针。

    “别动。最后一次瞬身步，你打算用来破阵旗。但你破了阵旗之后呢？灵力耗尽，瘫在地上，等着贺九的血煞爪撕开你的喉咙？”

    林尘没有回头。

    “你拦我做什么。陈元马上就要回来了，你不帮他抓我，反而来劝我别浪费灵力？”

    唐玉沉默了一瞬，然后松开他的肩膀，将银针收回袖中。
content_en:
When the leader walked in from outside the mountain gate, the cuffs of his blue robe were still stained with dew from the bamboo forest in the back mountain.
He was holding the long sword that was entirely green in color. The aura flowing on the sword was deep and restrained. Every step he took made the stone slabs on the rubble sink slightly.
Elder Qian and Elder Sun followed behind. Elder Sun was leaning on a bamboo stick, and Elder Qian was holding the magic measuring disk in his hand.
Elder Zhou of the Formation Hall walked at the end, with his head lowered and his sleeves bulging with unknown contents.
"He Jiu. The foreign affairs elder of the Blood Fiend Sect came to our Cangwu Sect to rob people, and even injured my elder. Do you think you can walk out of this mountain gate alive today?" The leader stopped and pointed his long sword diagonally at the ground.
He Jiu grinned, showing two rows of yellowed teeth.
"The leader personally takes action, I really can't defeat him. But before you come here, have you thought about one question - where is Chen Yuan?"
The leader didn't answer.
He Jiu nudged his chin toward the back mountain, "He went to the medicinal material warehouse to get the last few medicinal materials for the Human Puppet Technique. He will come back after at most one stick of incense. When he comes back, you will not only have to face the three of us from the Blood Evil Sect - but also a Chaos Holy Body Human Puppet whose consciousness has been wiped out. Guess what his first order was."
The master's hand holding the sword did not change at all.
But Mr. Sun beside him suddenly felt an extremely weak spiritual energy wave coming from outside the mountain gate - extremely weak, but extremely cold, as if something was drilling out from under the ground.
The ground outside the mountain gate cracked.
A gray-white figure emerged from the cracks in the ground, bringing up a piece of gravel and soil.
It was in the shape of a person—but not quite human anymore.
The gray-white skin is tightly stretched on the bones, the eye sockets are sunken, and the eyes have turned gray-white. The lips are shriveled and shrunk, revealing two complete rows of teeth.
He was wearing a shabby Taoist robe, the style was the old style of Cangwu Sect thirty years ago, with the emblem of Cangwu Sect - a goshawk with spread wings embroidered on the chest.
The leader looked at the Taoist robe, and the hand holding the sword tightened suddenly.
"Han Tu."
Korean picture.
The former head of the Cangwu Sect and the current head of the Cangwu Sect, his senior brother, "went crazy and died" in seclusion thirty years ago.
What is recorded in the sect's classics is that he died suddenly and no bones were left.
Now he stands here - or rather, his body stands here.
Han Tu's head turned stiffly, his gray-white eyes were aimed at the leader, and he grinned with an extremely weird smile.
Then he moved - there was no burst of spiritual power, no sword energy breaking through the air, he rushed directly towards the leader, and clawed at the leader's face with his five fingers.
The leader blocked with his sword, and a string of sparks exploded the moment the sword collided with his nails.
Han Tu's fingers were blown open by the sword light, and his fingertips made a harsh friction sound on the sword - his nails maintained the toughness they had in life, without breaking or even deforming.
"Didn't you go crazy thirty years ago?" The leader's voice was so low that it was almost inaudible, "It was Chen Yuan."
Han Tu did not answer.
He couldn't answer anymore.
There was no trace of consciousness left in his eyes, only the holes left after being made into a human puppet.
He Jiu took advantage of the leader's distraction to deal with Han Tu and walked around behind him, grabbing the leader's lower back with five dark red nails.
If this claw is grasped firmly, the toxins from the Blood Demon Claw can directly seep into the master's Dantian.
At this moment, Elder Zhou took out a formation flag from his sleeve - a dark red flag embroidered with densely packed forbidden runes. This was not the Cangwu Sect's formation, but the Blood Evil Sect's Blood Evil Trap Spirit Formation.
"Elder Zhou!" Elder Sun suddenly turned his head and tapped his bamboo stick on the ground, "What are you doing!"
Elder Zhou did not answer.
His forehead was sweating and his hands were shaking, but the formation flag had been activated.
Dark red formations spread out from the flag and quickly expanded along the ground into a huge circular formation, covering the leader, Han Tu, He Jiu and the two Blood Evil Sect protectors.
"What happened to Head Han thirty years ago... I was involved in." Elder Zhou's voice was shaking so much that he could hardly hear it, but every word was clearly transmitted to the ears of everyone present. "When Chen Yuan poisoned Han Tu, I helped him open the ban on Han Tu's retreat. I am the elder of the Formation Hall.I can undo the restrictions on that door.Later, he made Han Tu a puppet, and he took advantage of it - the formation map of the secret room had my spiritual mark, and he kept the formation map for thirty years.I helped him steal a lot of spiritual stones from the sect, and I couldn't help it."
The veins in Mr. Sun's hand, which he was holding on to the bamboo cane, popped out.
Han Tu was his junior brother. He died suddenly thirty years ago and his body was not found. He searched for three whole years but found nothing.
Now Han Tu's corpse was standing in front of him, transformed into a moving puppet.
His bamboo stick hit the stone slab hard, and he rushed towards Elder Zhou. The spiritual power of the Wanxiang Heart Sutra condensed on the bamboo stick into a pale white light blade, and smashed it towards Elder Zhou's head and face.
"You fucking beast!" Mr. Sun struck down one stick after another, each stick carrying thirty years of anger.
Elder Zhou was forced to the edge of the formation, and two fine lines had cracked on the formation flag, but he never fought back - it was not that he couldn't beat Elder Sun, he knew that he was not qualified to fight back.
The leader was attacked from both sides by Han Tu and He Jiu in the trapped spirit formation.
Han Tu's attacks did not have any spiritual power fluctuations, relying solely on his physical speed and remaining fighting instincts from his life. However, his swordsmanship was extremely high during his lifetime, and his attack angles were so tricky that even the leader had to withdraw his sword and defend.
He Jiu's bloody claws were specialized in the lower body. Every time the leader raised his sword to block Han Tu's frontal impact, he would grab the leader's legs and waist from the side and behind.
The two Blood Evil Sect guardians used Blood Shadow Steps to harass the outsiders, preventing the leader from breaking out of the formation's gap.
Lin Chen rushed down from the rubble.
Less than 20% of the spiritual power in his body was left. The Broken Star was taken away by Chen Yuan, and the dagger was already blunt when used against Song Qin.
But he saw the formation flag at the feet of Elder Zhou - the core of the trapped spirit formation was on the formation flag. As long as the formation flag was broken, the trapped spirit formation would dissipate.
There was one last step left for him to move.
Elder Zhou blocked Elder Sun's bamboo stick with a flag, moved two steps to the right to avoid the pursuit, and moved to less than three steps in front of Lin Chen.
Right now - just as Lin Chen was about to launch his instant step, a hand grabbed his shoulder from behind.
The hand was cold, there were thick calluses on the fingertips, and the nails were glowing with a dark purple sheen.
Tang Yu stood behind him, holding a slender silver needle in his other hand.
"Don't move. You planned to use the last teleportation step to break the formation flag. But what happens after you break the formation flag? Your spiritual power is exhausted and you collapse on the ground, waiting for He Jiu's bloody claws to rip your throat out?"
Lin Chen did not look back.
"Why are you stopping me? Chen Yuan is coming back soon. Instead of helping him catch me, you come to persuade me not to waste my spiritual energy?"
Tang Yu was silent for a moment, then let go of his shoulder and put the silver needle back into his sleeve.
